jobs.description: Build AI Home voice/chat agents, adaptive automation, and connected services, alongside enterprise customer and system integrator portals.
achievements: Deliver enterprise-grade customer and system integrator portals with end-to-end ownership, earning recognition from the CEO.
Resolve partner and client support tickets, turning technical findings and feedback into product improvements.
Build event-driven automation and LLM tool execution with RabbitMQ workers, bounded retries, and reconciliation.
Contribute to autonomous AI Home automation with learned device patterns, sensor context, and user approval.
Develop knowledge grounding and AI guardrails, with 105 evaluation scenarios covering tool use, prompt injection, and room isolation.
Connect hospitality, CRM, and billing workflows through Oracle OPERA/OHIP, smart-device platforms, HubSpot, and Chargebee.
Implement Auth0/OIDC authentication, server-side authorization, and Cloudflare-protected gateway access.
Deploy Docker services on AWS EC2/Linux, add OpenTelemetry/Grafana monitoring, and support CI/CD releases.

jobs.description: Owned enterprise SaaS and real estate CRM delivery across frontend, backend, hosting, and client deployments, working directly with owners and the CEO.
achievements: Designed multi-tenant HRMS/CRM with company isolation, 100+ permissions, 200+ REST endpoints, and a 100+ table schema.
Owned real estate CRM frontend, backend gateways, hosting, and on-premises client deployments, including AI matching, bulk imports, and Bayut/PropertyFinder integrations.
Delivered Fincore RMS contracts, payments, KYC, and maintenance workflows with 55+ reusable components and 15+ master-data modules.
Built ERP finance/inventory APIs; optimized data access with Redis, indexing, and pagination, and added Socket.io updates.
Collaborated directly with real estate owners and the CEO to understand issues and improve CRM workflows.

coverLetter.opening: I bring 5 years of experience delivering enterprise and AI products, with end-to-end ownership in startup environments.
body: At CASABOT, I contribute to voice/chat agents, adaptive home automation, and enterprise portals. My delivery of customer and system integrator portals earned recognition from the CEO. I also resolve partner and client engineering issues and turn their feedback into product improvements.

My experience spans system design, event-driven services, AI knowledge grounding and evaluations, secure authentication, and cloud operations. Previously, I owned real estate CRM frontend and backend delivery, hosting, and on-premises deployments, working directly with real estate owners and the CEO.
coverLetter.closing: Please find my CV attached for your consideration. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your engineering needs.
